sharedFields.priceSource: FITNESS SF official membership and pass help pages
sharedFields.priceNote: The current All-Gym Access plan is $134.95/month and includes every open San Francisco location. FITNESS SF publishes no enrollment, sign-up, or annual fee; a full first and final month are upfront dues. The ordinary all-gym one-day pass is $35; the $30 member-hosted rate is restricted and not selected.
